reason: Our notices already go out on WhatsApp groups and the ERP portal, and I cannot take a ₹9 lakh line item to the committee for a problem I have not shown exists. At most I might table the free pilot for discussion, but nothing gets bought this month.
objection: Students already get every notice on WhatsApp, so I would be paying lakhs for a second channel, and on top of that a small startup wants access to our Microsoft 365 and ERP with student data, which IT and the trustees will question hard.
would_change_my_mind: A pilot report from our own batch showing a clear, measurable drop in missed submissions and exams, plus IT sign-off on the data access and DPDP agreement.
